newsitem.title: POLAND: French Guyomarch buys feed firm from Polish NFIs.
newsitem.headline: French Guyomarch buys feed firm from Polish NFIs.

text.p: France's Guyomarch Nutrition Animale SA has agreed to pay National Investment Funds (NFI) 3.6 million zlotys for a 60 percent stake in feed maker Ilpasz SA in Poland's mass privatisation scheme, NFI 11 said in a statement.

"NFI 11 signed a conditional contract on the sale of Ilpasz's shares. A 60 percent stake was purchased by French Guyomarch Nutrition Animale SA....The stake price amounts to 3.6 million zlotys," NFI 11, one of 15 funds making up NFI, said on Thursday.
NFI 11 held 33 percent of Ilpasz's shares, and other funds owned 27 percent.
NFI 11 said payment would be made in two instalments, 60 percent within 14 days after contract signature and 40 percent thereafter.
The deal still needs the approval of the Interior Ministry and anti-monopoly office.
